label: Diagram 2.8
caption: Diagram 2.8 Extension of corridor beyond a protected stairway
description: This drawing is a plan, captioned at the bottom "Diagram 2.8 Extension of corridor beyond a protected stairway", with the note "See para 2.24" at the top left. It contains two side-by-side plans, labelled "Example 1" and "Example 2". Each plan shows walls in thick black line, a grey-hatched area with curved steps forming a staircase, indicated by a leader line to the label "Protected stairway", with a jagged break line on its left wall and another jagged break line at the bottom. In Example 1, a corridor extends vertically to the right of the stairway and opens at the top into two doorways, each drawn with a quarter-circle door leaf; a green double-headed dimension line marked "2m max." measures the corridor's length from the stairway line to the top wall. In Example 2, a similar corridor extends upward to a single doorway at the top, shown with a black door leaf and a quarter-circle arc, and is again dimensioned "2m max." along its length.
